SPECIFICATION FOR 

SLOTTED ROUND HEAD WOOD SCREWS 


■S; 6739-1972 

(Reaffirmed 2004) 


(Reaffirnned 2015) 


1. Scope — Requirements for slotted round head wood screws. 

2. Material — Shall conform to the requirements laid down in IS : 451-1972 ' Technical supply condi¬ 
tions for wood screws . 

3. Dimensions and Tolerances 

3.1 The slotted round head wood screws shall conform to dimensions given in Table 1. 

3.2 The tolerances shall conform to those given in Fig. 1. 


= 2IT14 



9012 



-IT 15 — 


FIG. 1 TOLERANCES FOR SLOTTED ROUND HEAD WOOD SCREWS 
3.3 The preferred length, screw number combinations are given in Table 2. 

4. Designation — Wood screws shall be designated by the screw number ( screw designation ), length, 
the number of this standard and material. 

Example: 

A slotted round head wood screw No. 8, length 20 mm and made of steel shall be 
designated as: 

Wood Screw No. 8 x 20 IS : 6739 Steel 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 The wood screws shall be manufactured conforming to the form and dimensions given in Fig. 1 and 
Table 1. The screws shall conform to IS:451-1972 in respect of requirements not covered in this 
standard. ,,, ,, ^ 

/ \,jonndu!nSia„5'^' 

6. Finish —As given in IS : 451-1972. / ^ \

7. Packing — The wood screws shall be packed as 

8. Inspection and Acceptance — As given in 18:451-1972. 

9. Marking — As given in IS : 451-1972. 

9.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Wood screws were originally coverd in IS : 451 published in 1961. Consequent on the revision 
of this standard, four separate standards are being published as follows: 

IS : 451-1972 Technical supply conditions for wood screws 

IS : 6736-1972 Specification for slotted raised countersunk head wood screws 

IS : 6739-1972 Specification for slotted round head wood screws 

IS : 6760-1972 Specification for slotted countersunk head wood screws 

The sizes of wood screws incorporated in the above standards are based on the size of wi^e 
gauges. Metric dimensions of these sizes are also given in the individual standards. The contractual 
clauses covered in the earlier version of the standard have since been deleted in the revised version
